It was such a fun game! 😢🙄👎🏼

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Don’t download and pay to play this game, unless you just want to play for fun and not money. You can’t really make any money due to the cost of each money game. Also what it shows you have in funds you can’t actually withdraw. And if you don’t actually play often they will charge you a maintenance fee!! Been logging in every single day for months to do the daily checkin haven’t actually played for a while and they tell me they are going to charge a $2.00 monthly service fee??? For what? They don’t provide any service? I am deleting my account and will not go back and I’m letting them keep the little money that could be withdrawn as they would refund in a check and I will be dammed if I will give them my address. I truly think a class action suit against these people for fraud is in order.
